title: OpenTelemetry (OTLP) observability: metrics, traces, logs
description:
Add OpenTelemetry instrumentation so operators can feed metrics, traces, and logs to any standard backend (Grafana Cloud, Datadog, CloudWatch, Honeycomb, Jaeger) via a single OTLP exporter, without changing application code.

Why this issue exists:
The project already has a Prometheus /metrics endpoint and JSON structured logs, but no distributed tracing and no OTLP export. Enterprise operators — especially on AWS Marketplace — expect OTel-native instrumentation. The OTel Collector sidecar handles fan-out to whatever backend the operator uses; the application just needs to speak OTLP.

Scope:

## Metrics
- Add opentelemetry + opentelemetry-otlp crates alongside the existing Prometheus endpoint
- Expose the same metrics via OTLP push to a configurable collector endpoint
- Keep the Prometheus /metrics scrape endpoint — it is still expected by Kubernetes and self-hosted operators
- Configurable: OTLP endpoint URL, push interval, TLS, headers (for auth tokens)

## Traces
- Instrument the critical paths with OTel spans:
  - NNTP command dispatch (one span per command, tagged with command name and group)
  - POST pipeline: receive → serialize → sign → IPFS write → group log append
  - Gossipsub reconcile loop: per-group reconcile span with want/have counts as attributes
  - JMAP method dispatch: one span per method call
  - Kubo HTTP RPC calls: block_put and block_get spans with CID and latency
- Propagate trace context across transit→reader IHAVE/TAKETHIS calls (W3C traceparent header)
- Configurable: OTLP traces endpoint, sampling rate (default 1.0 for low-volume usenet, tunable)

## Logs
- Attach trace_id and span_id to every tracing-subscriber log record so logs can be correlated with traces in backends that support it (Grafana Tempo + Loki, Datadog, Honeycomb)
- JSON log format already in place; add OTel log bridge (opentelemetry-appender-tracing) to also push logs via OTLP if a logs endpoint is configured
- Logs endpoint is optional — operators who prefer log shipping via Fluent Bit/Vector from stdout can continue to do so

## Configuration (new [telemetry] section in each daemon config)


## AWS Marketplace target
- Document AWS Distro for OpenTelemetry (ADOT) collector sidecar setup in RUNBOOK.md
- CloudWatch Metrics, X-Ray traces, and CloudWatch Logs as the default AWS backend
- CloudFormation snippet for ADOT sidecar in the Marketplace deployment template

## Out of scope
- Custom OTel collector deployment (that is the operator's job)
- Baggage propagation beyond traceparent/tracestate
- Profiling (continuous profiling is a separate concern)

Acceptance criteria:
- cargo test --workspace passes with telemetry feature enabled
- A local OTel Collector + Grafana stack (docker-compose) receives metrics, traces, and logs from a running transit+reader pair
- The Prometheus /metrics endpoint continues to work unchanged
- NNTP POST end-to-end trace is visible in Grafana Tempo with spans for each pipeline stage
- OTLP export disabled by default (no [telemetry] section = Prometheus only, no OTLP traffic)
